bio.text: Dewey McClain was sworn in on December 5, 2013, as the representative for Georgia's 109th House District.

McClain is president of the Atlanta North Georgia Labor Council AFL-CIO and retired from the City of Atlanta after 18 years with its Parks, Recreation and Cultural Affairs department and four years with the Atlanta Workforce Development Agency.
Before city employment, McClain played five years in the NFL with the Falcons and two years in the USFL.
